translations.definition: n. 放鬆、休息；緩和、減輕（緊張或壓力）

examples.en: After three weeks of intense negotiations, the executive finally carved out an afternoon for pure relaxation.

translations.zh-TW: 經過三週密集談判之後，那位主管終於空出一個下午純粹放鬆休息。

examples.en: Progressive relaxations of the trade tariffs boosted cross-border demand for imported electronics.

translations.zh-TW: 貿易關稅的逐步放寬，提升了跨國對進口電子產品的需求。

examples.en: The chair massage service was marketed as a brief relaxation between back-to-back meetings.

translations.zh-TW: 那項坐椅按摩服務被宣傳為一場接一場會議之間的短暫放鬆時光。

translations.definition: n. 重複、重做；背誦；副本、複製品

examples.en: Constant repetition of the safety slogan helped employees internalize the protocol within weeks.

translations.zh-TW: 安全標語不斷重複，幫助員工在數週內就把流程內化。

examples.en: Endless repetitions of the disclaimer at the start of every call irritated long-time customers.

translations.zh-TW: 每通電話開頭無止盡重複同一份免責聲明，惹恼了長期客戶。

examples.en: The trainer warned that mere repetition without feedback rarely produces lasting improvement.

translations.zh-TW: 培訓師警告，光靠重複而缺乏回饋，很少能帶來持久的進步。

translations.definition: n. 撤退、退避；靜修所、避居地  v. 撤退、退避；隱居

examples.en: Facing fierce price competition, the startup retreated from the high-end market to focus on budget customers.

translations.zh-TW: 面對激烈的價格競爭，那家新創公司從高端市場撤退，轉而聚焦預算型客戶。

examples.en: The annual leadership retreat brings department heads together outside the city for two days of strategy planning.

translations.zh-TW: 年度領導人靜修營將各部門主管聚到城外，進行為期兩天的策略規劃。

examples.en: With the front line collapsing, retreating troops were ordered to regroup behind the river.

translations.zh-TW: 隨著前線崩潰，撤退中的部隊奉命在河對岸重新集結。

translations.definition: n. 沙龍、美容院、髮廊；大會客室、藝文展覽廳

examples.en: The flagship hair salon on Fifth Avenue books out three weeks ahead during fashion week.

translations.zh-TW: 第五大道上的旗艦髮廊在時裝週期間預約會排到三週之後。

examples.en: Independent beauty salons are feeling the squeeze as chain brands slash their membership fees.

translations.zh-TW: 隨著連鎖品牌大幅調降會員費，獨立美容院正面臨生存壓力。

examples.en: A literary salon hosted by the embassy draws expatriate writers and translators every other Thursday.

translations.zh-TW: 由大使館主辦的文學沙龍，每兩週的週四吸引外籍作家與譯者聚會。

translations.definition: n. 風景、景色（集合名詞，不可數）；舞台布景

examples.en: The coastal train route offers some of the most spectacular scenery in the country.

translations.zh-TW: 這條沿海鐵路沿線能欣賞到國內最壯麗的風景之一。

examples.en: Expanded theater scenery required four stagehands and an extra storage bay backstage.

translations.zh-TW: 擴充後的舞台布景需要四名舞台工作人員，後台也得另騰出一個儲藏間。

examples.en: Event designers digitally preview the scenery before a single piece of the set is built.

translations.zh-TW: 活動設計師在搭出任何一塊布景之前，都會先用數位方式預覽整體場景。

translations.definition: n. 連載小說、連播節目  a. 連續的、一系列的；分期連載的；串列的

examples.en: The investigative podcast launched as a weekly serial that racked up two million downloads in a month.

translations.zh-TW: 那檔調查報導類 Podcast 以每週連載形式推出，一個月內就累積兩百萬次下載。

examples.en: Streaming platforms compete aggressively for exclusive serials to differentiate their catalogs.

translations.zh-TW: 串流平台之間激烈爭搶獨家連播節目，藉以拉開彼此片單的差異。

examples.en: A serial acquisition strategy helped the insurer quickly absorb three regional rivals in two years.

translations.zh-TW: 憑藉連番收購的策略，那家保險公司兩年內迅速併吞三家地方競爭對手。

translations.definition: n. 草圖、素描、簡短描述；短篇喜劇  v. 畫草圖、概述

examples.en: The architect sketched the proposed tower on a napkin during a long-haul flight.

translations.zh-TW: 建築師在一趟長途航班上，隨手在餐巾紙上畫下那座規劃中高塔的草圖。

examples.en: Early sketches of the product packaging revealed how quickly the brand identity evolved.

translations.zh-TW: 產品包裝早期的草圖，能看出品牌識別演變的速度有多快。

examples.en: Sketching the workflow on a whiteboard exposed bottlenecks no one had noticed in the spec doc.

translations.zh-TW: 在白板上概略畫出工作流程，反而暴露了文件中沒人察覺的瓶頸。

examples.en: The carrier bundles a mid-range smartphone with every two-year contract to lock in subscribers.

translations.zh-TW: 電信商把一款中階智慧型手機搭進每份兩年合約，藉以綁定訂閱用戶。

examples.en: Refurbished smartphones now account for nearly thirty percent of the distributor's quarterly revenue.

translations.zh-TW: 翻新的智慧型手機如今佔該經銷商季度營收近三成。

examples.en: A reliable smartphone with all-day battery life has become a baseline requirement for field technicians.

translations.zh-TW: 電量能撐一整天的可靠智慧型手機，已成了外勤技師的基本要求。

translations.definition: v. 急升、猛漲、飆升；翱翔、高飛

examples.en: Energy prices soared after the pipeline disruption, catching corporate budgets off guard.

translations.zh-TW: 管線中斷之後能源價格飆升，讓企業預算猝不及防。

examples.en: Demand for cloud storage soars every December as retailers run peak-season backups.

translations.zh-TW: 每到十二月零售業執行旺季備份時，雲端儲存的需求就會飆升。

examples.en: With soaring raw-material costs, the manufacturer quietly raised list prices across three product lines.

translations.zh-TW: 由於原物料成本節節攀升，製造商悄悄調高了三條產品線的建議售價。

translations.definition: n. 刺激、激勵因素；（經濟）振興措施、刺激方案

examples.en: The central bank's interest-rate cut was designed as a stimulus for sluggish consumer spending.

translations.zh-TW: 央行調降利率是為了替疲軟的消費支出提供振興刺激。

examples.en: Competitive grants and tax breaks have proven useful stimuli for early-stage green technology.

translations.zh-TW: 競爭型補助與租稅減免，已證實是激勵早期綠色技術的有效刺激方案。

examples.en: A new product launch can act as a stimulus that lifts an entire division's quarterly morale.

translations.zh-TW: 一場新產品發表會，可以成為拉抬整個部門季度士氣的激勵因素。
